title: breast-mri-core: late-phase removal and SER-filtered tumor volume in breast MRI (analysis code and derived scores)
description:
Analysis code and derived scores for a study of how removing the late post-contrast phase changes signal-enhancement-ratio (SER) filtered functional tumor volume in breast MRI, and how much that change affects discrimination of pathological complete response (pCR) after neoadjuvant therapy.

The study uses the public ACRIN-6698 / I-SPY 2 collection of The Cancer Imaging Archive (BMMR2 training subset, 117 participants, pre-treatment and early-treatment visits). The directory supplementary_data_s1 is byte-identical to the manuscript's Supplementary Data S1: the paired patient scores, a script that reproduces all 20 reported AUC comparisons and outcome-stratified bootstrap intervals to within 1e-12, the frozen results, and an archival snapshot of the image-processing and analysis scripts with their plans and provenance.

No MRI data is redistributed. The source images are obtained from The Cancer Imaging Archive under CC BY 4.0.
